circuit.name: 5t-ota
circuit.rationale: Iteration 0 crashed: 180u single-device widths exceed the PDK's binned W range, so no model bound. Same electrical design re-expressed as parallel units (per-unit W<=10u with m multipliers, totals unchanged). With valid models, tail ~60uA gives gm1~0.8mS: GBW~25MHz, gain~45dB, PM>80deg.
